name: h2_electrolyzer_fuel_cell
title: Water electrolyser and H2/O2 fuel cell (TESPy WaterElectrolyzer and FuelCell)
summary: Both directions of the hydrogen electrochemical reaction in one file: water electrolyser (power in, H2 and O2 out) and H2/O2 fuel cell (power out), with species mass flows from the stoichiometry, energy balance with the formation enthalpy, HHV and LHV efficiencies, heat to a cooling-water stream, an eta characteristic for part load and a power-to-power round trip.

origin.course: TESPy components WaterElectrolyzer (TSP-024) and FuelCell (TSP-025), commit 19425523; verification against their docstring examples and tests/test_components/test_reactors.py

verification.summary: TESPy docstring examples and test_reactors.py cases re-run in a throw-away venv (7 cases): 90 common variables agree with CoolSolve, 0 differ at rtol 1e-9 (max relative 1.7e-9). The TESPy fuel-cell heat output violates the first law (sign of P); it is compared with a one-line sign-patched TESPy. e0 checked against the CoolSolve species (HHV 285.83 vs 286.0 kJ/mol).
verification.reference: TESPy 0.11.3.dev0 (local clone commit 19425523, CoolProp 8.0.0; CoolSolve build with CoolProp 8.1.0dev): electrolyser docstring design and 20 % off-design, two test_reactors.py cases and the eta = 1 case; fuel cell docstring, test_reactors.py case and a round-trip case. Fuel-cell heat and cooling flow against the same TESPy with the sign of P in FuelCell.energy_balance_func changed
verification.notes: compare_solution.py against the TESPy values (90 variables): 0 differ at rtol=1e-09 (default atol 1e-9), 11 differ at rtol=1e-10; maximum purely relative deviation 1.7e-9 (a script of the work folder), the solver tolerance. Unmodified TESPy gives a fuel-cell heat output 2.66 times the CoolSolve value (641.5 kW instead of 241.5 kW at 200 kW output, more than the chemical input of 444.4 kW): TESPy bug, see README.

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of the TESPy WaterElectrolyzer and FuelCell, card C-443, inventory rows TSP-024 and TSP-025); verified against 7 TESPy runs
